g.text: Pauli-JW: saved Hybrid / pure-RTE comparisons and N / C / G
H2/H4/H6: linear1 Å/STO-3G; Pauli14/184/918; saved molecule-specific H/state/reference; T=.8/S2; central control; P=0; Qiskit1.3/opt1/seed17; hypothetical compiled ρ=0.
Original saved comparison direction: pure RTE lower G in 14/15 conditions; H4 ε=.05 is the Hybrid exception. H6 uses the later p78/q8/r32/K2 Hybrid, not the older anchor.
G bars are ±1 saved price-sample SE, not population intervals. N is analytic, not observed shots. Same prices are reused across precision; these are not 15 independent
Original fixed nominees / confirmation-after-selection / sequential extension are retained in the data manifest. Pauli constant is retained. Coincident cos/sin means are
